name: Mombo Combo Legacy
description:
About This Game

A high-energy platformer packed with action and adventure! Battle monstrous enemies and take on insane challenges to unleash jaw-dropping combos. Unlock powerful forms and master MOMBÁSTIC abilities as you explore unforgettable worlds!

✨ Master incredible combos across hundreds of levels! ✨

Journey through epic worlds, each filled with tougher enemies and deadlier traps. Complete unique challenges in every stage to trigger a MOMBO COMBO! How high can you score on each level?

🔥 Unlock powerful new forms! 🔥

Transform Mombo to reach impossible heights and break speed limits! Each form comes with special abilities you can unlock to customize your playstyle. Get ready to take your combos to absolutely insane levels!

👑 Style your Mombo with awesome skins! 👑

Collect fabulous skins and combo your way through the world in style! Choose a unique look for each form and swap whenever you like. Each skin is cooler than the last!

🐯 Collect and evolve your pets! 🐯

Find Orumons to join you on your adventure! Each one boosts you in a different way. Evolve them to become stronger and mix and match your Orumon team to create unbeatable strategies!

🏆 Take down monstrous bosses! 🏆

Think you’ve got what it takes to crush the most terrifying bosses around? The world is counting on the prophesized hero once again. Show them who’s the boss with skill, courage… and a whole lot of tongue!
short_desc: The most tongue-tastic hero is back! Jump, fight, and complete MOMBO COMBOS in a new journey packed with action, intense challenges, and monstrous bosses. Explore new worlds in this 2D platformer with powerful forms and a mighty army of pets! The world needs our little purple hero once again!
